# Aroha

> Aroha is a self-care web app for young adults living with generalised anxiety. It is a companion, not a medical service, and it does not diagnose or treat.

## What it does
- Log mood and anxiety symptoms, with a weekly summary of patterns (no streaks)
- Estimate heart rate with the phone camera; log temperature from a thermometer
- SOS sheet: guided breathing, 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, one-tap messages to trusted contacts, and region-aware crisis helplines
- Safe box for happy memories, photos and voice notes
- To-dos that break tasks into small steps
- Short reads on anxiety, self-compassion and grounding

## Privacy
All data stays in the user's browser on their device. There is no server and no tracking. Users can download or delete their data at any time.

## Audience
Adults aged 18 and over.
